calendarFaqs.q: When does Randolph County School System start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for RCSS students is Monday, August 23, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is RCSS spring break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: RCSS lists Spring Annual Leave from April 10 through April 13, 2028. Students are also off April 14 for a Holiday and April 17 for a Workday; the next scheduled school day is Tuesday, April 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for RCSS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, June 7, 2028, with a two-hour early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Do RCSS students have school on teacher workdays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The Workdays shown on this page are student no-school dates unless RCSS activates one under its weather make-up schedule or announces another change.

calendarFaqs.q: How does RCSS handle weather make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar says RCSS will absorb the first five closure days, including time lost to delays, and then use its printed make-up schedule if needed. That schedule lists November 24, January 19, March 7, and April 17. Wait for RCSS confirmation before treating a Workday as a student attendance day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official RCSS 2027–28 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF button on this page or open the Randolph County School System calendars page. The 2027–28 PDF was approved February 9, 2026.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed Aug. 17, 2026 using the official one-page RCSS 2027–28 calendar approved February 9, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: We reviewed the full one-page RCSS calendar PDF and checked the dates used on this page.
We confirmed 180 student days from the four printed grading-period totals: 45 + 43 + 45 + 47.
We combine adjacent Workday, Annual Leave, and Holiday dates only in the family-facing no-school summary; the complete date list retains the PDF’s calendar terminology.
We confirmed the 2027–28 printed rule: RCSS absorbs the first five closure days, then uses the semester-specific make-up schedule if needed.
